channel.title: DUKAAN — Editorial Journal & Monographs
channel.description: Curated investigations into textile botany, architectural silhouette geometries, European linen care, and unstructured tailoring dialogues.

item.title: The Architecture of Normandy Flax: From Coastal Field to Garment
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Elena Rostova)
item.description: True luxury lies in botanical patience. We trace the three-month journey of our certified raw flax from coastal French soil through gentle dew-retting to our weaving mills in Porto.

item.title: European Linen vs Conventional Cotton: The Definitive Guide for Tropical Climates
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Julian Vance)
item.description: When humidity rises above 70%, conventional cotton tends to saturate and cling. We analyze the molecular difference that makes pure European linen the superior textile for Indian summers.

item.title: Why Double Gauze Cotton is the Ultimate Humidity-Resistant Fabric
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Sofia Lindqvist)
item.description: Double gauze connects two micro-fine plies with invisible tacking points, creating an insulating air buffer that lifts fabric off the body. Learn why it is the definitive resort wear textile.

item.title: How to Build a 10-Garment Minimalist Capsule Wardrobe for 2026
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Julian Vance)
item.description: Eliminate closet fatigue and consumerist clutter. Discover how ten thoughtfully tailored garments in neutral earthy tones unlock thirty-six interchangeable outfits.

item.title: The Caretaker’s Manual: How to Wash, Dry, and Preserve Pure Linen
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Elena Rostova)
item.description: Pure linen is one of the few textiles that becomes softer, stronger, and more luminous with every wash cycle. Follow our master guide to ensure your garments last for decades.

item.title: Conversations on Unstructured Tailoring: Deconstructing Floating Canvases
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Julian Vance)
item.description: In our Neapolitan workshop, tailor Marco Vieri explains why the absence of padding exposes every seam to scrutiny, and how floating canvas allows a garment to breathe with the wearer.

item.title: Mediterranean Light & Architectural Form: Campaign 04 Location Study
item.author: priyanshubipin2006@gmail.com (Sofia Lindqvist)
item.description: Exploring the geometry of raw limestone, harsh midday shadows, and the gentle drape of double-gauze holiday textiles along the Balearic coastline.
